-- Let's check: what's the total net balance across all customers as of each month
-- Just sum up the net of all transactions for each month
WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR) as txn_month,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
            WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) as month_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) AS VARCHAR)
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_net
ORDER BY txn_month
